evidence.fixComment: FIX-001: Fix NULL current->mem vulnerability (exec window bug) - Set current->mm and current->mem to NULL BEFORE calling mm_release() to prevent dangling pointers during the window between release and task_set_mm

summary: Tested 2 assertions: VAL-DIAG-004 (Root cause identified) and VAL-DIAG-005 (Fix implemented and verified). Both assertions PASSED. Trace subsystem is functional with 10 trace tests passing.
